title.narrative: Strengthening malaria control operations and reducing the malaria burden to move progressively towards malaria elimination in Laos - Lao (Peoples Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Lao (Peoples Democratic Republic), Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Lao People's Democratic Republic (MOH)This program has the following goals: Strengthen malaria control operations, support regional artemisinin resistance containment efforts and move progressively towards elimination in Laos. The objectives of this program are: Objective: Improve access to and early utilization of diagnosis and appropriate treatment for malaria at public health facilities as well. Objective: Maximize access to and utilization of effective vector control and personal protection measures.. Objective: Optimize the functionality of national malaria control, containment and elimination efforts by strengthening programme management.. Objective: Progressively roll-out malaria elimination in selected provinces
